categories.main_business_segments: Yusin Holding Corp. primarily develops, manufactures, processes, and trades automotive brake system components including brake master cylinders, brake cylinders, brake calipers, two-wheel brake assemblies, and brake pads. The company serves both the aftermarket (AM) and original equipment manufacturer (OEM) markets, with a focus on brake system parts and expanding into clutch components and brake pads.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing processes such as casting, stamping, forging, machining, heat treatment, and assembly. It integrates automation and semi-automation equipment including robotic arms to improve production efficiency and quality. R&D focuses on new product development like electronic parking brake (EPB) calipers, plastic clutch master cylinders, and high-performance ceramic brake pads, supported by reverse engineering and computer-aided inspection technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Yusin serves automotive component aftermarket distributors and large chain retailers primarily in North America, Asia-Pacific (including China), Central and South America, and Europe. Key OEM customers include Chinese self-owned brands such as BYD, Great Wall Motor, Changan Automobile, and Guangzhou Automobile Group. The company targets both aftermarket and OEM segments with a growing focus on new energy vehicles (NEVs).
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with major markets in North America (36.7% of revenue), Asia-Pacific (49.8%), Central and South America, and Europe. Manufacturing facilities are located in China (Xiamen, Fuzhou), Malaysia, and subsidiaries in the United States and Samoa. The company actively expands production capacity in China and Malaysia to serve these markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yusin operates primarily in the midstream manufacturing segment of the automotive brake system supply chain, producing key components such as brake master cylinders, calipers, and brake pads. It maintains close integration with upstream raw material suppliers (aluminum, iron, rubber) and downstream distributors and OEMs, aiming to strengthen supply chain coordination and increase in-house production rates.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment to develop new brake calipers, EPB systems, plastic clutch master cylinders, and brake pad materials for NEVs. It emphasizes automation, process optimization, and quality control improvements. Strategic goals include expanding OEM business in China, increasing caliper production capacity, integrating supply chain resources, and enhancing sustainable development and corporate governance.
categories.revenue_model: Yusin generates revenue mainly through product sales of automotive brake system components to aftermarket distributors, OEMs, and automotive manufacturers. Revenue is derived from direct sales contracts, commissions via subsidiaries, and long-term supply agreements. The company also invests in expanding production capacity to meet growing demand.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the aftermarket, competitors include Taiwan's Sanyi Brake Technology and China's SORL Auto Parts. In the Chinese OEM market, competitors include Zhejiang Wanbao, Zhejiang Asia Pacific, Jilin EMIS, and Anhui Wuhu BTL. Yusin positions itself as a quality-focused, technologically advanced manufacturer with a broad product range and global market reach, maintaining competitiveness through innovation and automation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Yusin reported operating revenue of approximately NT$3.92 billion, a 21.05% increase from 2023, driven by strong growth in caliper and brake pad sales. Net income after tax was NT$454.7 million, up 16.69%. The company has steadily increased assets and equity, expanded production capacity, and invested over NT$128 million in R&D. It maintains a healthy financial structure with ongoing profitability and growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yusin emphasizes high product quality, extensive product variety (over 6,000 types), and technological innovation tailored to evolving automotive safety and environmental standards. The company leverages automation and advanced manufacturing to ensure timely delivery and cost efficiency. Its focus on OEM partnerships, especially in China’s NEV market, and comprehensive after-sales support differentiates it in a competitive global market.
